# sherpa-select-checkbox

A labelled checkbox. Native &lt;input type="checkbox">; the visible box is drawn in CSS off :checked / :indeterminate / :disabled.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | Select Checkbox |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-select-checkbox/sherpa-select-checkbox.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-select-checkbox/sherpa-select-checkbox.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-select-checkbox/sherpa-select-checkbox.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-select-checkbox/sherpa-select-checkbox.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-select-checkbox/sherpa-select-checkbox.example.json) |

## When to use it

For one tick box with a label; `indeterminate` shows a mixed state, and `data-advanced` adds a menu of selection choices such as "Select all on page". For several options under one label, use `sherpa-select-group` with `multiple`; for an on/off that applies at once, use `sherpa-switch`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-select-checkbox data-label="Accept terms" data-description="Required to continue." name="terms"></sherpa-select-checkbox>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-advanced` | boolean |  | show the caret + its slotted menu |
| `data-description` | text |  | helper line below the label |
| `data-label` | text |  | label text to the right of the box (or default slot) |
| `checked` | boolean, native | `false` | native checked state (also a JS property) |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | native attributes, mirrored to the inner control |
| `indeterminate` | text, native |  | mixed state (JS property → input.indeterminate; CSS :indeterminate) |
| `name` | text, native |  | native attributes, mirrored to the inner control |
| `required` | boolean, native | `false` | native attributes, mirrored to the inner control |
| `value` | text, native | `on` | submitted value when checked |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions)` | Focus its control: the first focusable part inside. |
| `checkValidity()` | Is it acceptable, as its form sees it? |
| `reportValidity()` | Check, and show the browser's message on the control. |
| `formDisabledCallback()` | Inside a disabled `<fieldset>`, as by its own `disabled`. |
| `formResetCallback()` | A form reset puts back its FIRST `checked`. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `change` | `{ checked: boolean; indeterminate: false; value: string }` | Re-dispatched from the inner control. |
| `selection-scenario` | `{ value: string }` | A menu row was chosen. |
